title.narrative: Technical Assistance to the Fonplata Regional Framework Loan

description.narrative: The Bank Loan to Fonplata will be complemented by Technical Assistance to Fonplata in order to enhance the capacity of Fonplata and the Final Beneficiaries, by supporting climate risk and vulnerability assessments (CRVA) and training. This will enable Fonplata and Final Beneficiaries to include the climate resilience component in their Sub-Projects in the River Plate Basin and to identify more projects in the future with these characteristics.
